text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
......What a lovely day, like a gentle 
spring breeze. It seems lunch will be 
quite delicious.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Where should I eat today, I wonder—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Please waiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-san?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Today's 'Lunch with the 
Class Rep' voucher has splendidly been won 
by Miss Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The right to lunch with you... is it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Normally, come lunchtime, a Class Rep 
like me is in high demand!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, don't hold back today! Have me 
all to yourself!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! What a lovely spot! It's perfect for 
our lunch!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they are sun-dried. Though... it's a 
bit lonely today with no wind blowing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I've done my research! Knowing 
Zephyr-san wanted to bathe in the breeze, 
I borrowed something just for this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, please enjoy your meal to your 
heart's content in the breeze!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on, come ooon--!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah... A leaf got into my bento...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaaaa--?! What have I done?! I am so 
very sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No... I find this quite charming in its 
own way. A cool breeze... that makes you 
feel the season.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
!! S-So that means you aren't angry!? What 
incredible magnanimity!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...? I merely stated what was on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~! You're just being modest, aren't 
you! However, as the Class Rep, I cannot 
let things end like this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If there is anything I can do, please 
don't hesitate to consult me! This class 
representative will resolve it for you!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Then, there is one thing I would like 
to ask. Where does the source of your 
'whirlwind' lie, Bakushin O-san?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You mean the "crown" on my head, right?! 
It's right here, right here! Look at it to 
your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I see... So our very ways of thinking are 
completely different, then...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Then, one more question. What kind of 
efforts did you make to create that "hair 
whorl"?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's obviously washing it every day! 
Giving it a good scrub with the pads of 
your fingers feels super refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Stimulating the body and driving away the 
foul winds... If I adopt the mindset of a 
crisp autumn breeze, could I too command a 
whirlwind?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to work up a good lather! If 
you're scared of getting soap in your 
eyes, use a shampoo cap! Don't worry, I 
use one too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This was... a flurry of blossoms. Truly, 
the scales have fallen from my eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as lunch break was about to end, I 
saw Yamanin Zephyr and Sakura Bakushin O 
having a fun conversation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr and the others have 
lunchboxes in hand. It looks like they ate 
lunch together.
choice_data_list: You're not alone today, are you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san. Bakushin O-san has been 
teaching me all sorts of things.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Ask me anything! Your Class Rep 
will give you a clear-cut answer!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
She truly is a whirlwind of a person. She 
even taught me the source of her hair 
whirl, you know.

in races, too
I gotta train harder so I don't lose!

even taught me the source of her hair 
whirl, you know.
choice_data_list:

in races, too
I gotta train harder so I don't lose!
We gotta train harder so we don't lose!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to answer! The secret to my 
strength is that I am always bakushin-ing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
From wake-up to bedtime, always on 
Bakushin standby! Even during lunch break, 
Bakushin Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...! A gale that never ceases blowing. So 
that is the secret to your strength...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Yamanin Zephyr learned the 
Bakushin Mind!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... So that I, too, can stir up a 
"whirlwind"...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you would do well to take a page out 
of my book!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—when Yamanin Zephyr showed up 
for training, the expression on her face 
was different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's begin.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must be picturing her rivals in her 
mind. I could feel a fierce competitive 
spirit radiating from Yamanin Zephyr!
